props.heading: Software you can install in one line.
props.body: A headless CMS, the console that edits it, the renderer that publishes it and the tool that deploys the lot. Open source, MIT or MPL-2.0, already in other people's production.

props.heading: Install it
props.code:
dotnet add package BarakoCMS
docker compose up -d
barako open

props.label: barakoPress
props.code:
npm i barakopress
npx barakopress bindings-key baryo

props.label: BaryoVM
props.code:
dotnet tool install -g BaryoVM
baryovm up

props.name: barakoCMS
props.body: The headless CMS. Content types at runtime, event sourced, Postgres underneath.
props.label: Repo

props.name: barakoBrew
props.body: The console. Content, blocks, settings and the people who change them.
props.label: Repo

props.name: barakoPress
props.body: The renderer. Next.js server components, cached until the CMS says otherwise.
props.label: Repo

props.name: BaryoVM
props.body: The deploy tool. One VM, one command, the whole stack answering.
props.label: Repo

props.question: Is any of it metered?
props.answer: No. No seat cap, no paid tier, no metered anything.

props.question: Can I run it myself?
props.answer: That is the only way it runs. Your VM, your database, your domain.

props.heading: Keep the workshop lit.
props.body: Everything here is open source and self-hostable. No paid tier, no seat cap, no metered anything. Sponsorship buys the CI minutes and the coffee.
